summary_1line: Bhishma instructs Yudhishthira on righteousness, proper recipients of gifts and Sraddha offerings, ritual purity rules, and actions leading to merit or hell.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows while Yudhishthira stands beside him listening to teachings on righteousness.
A solemn Sraddha ritual with offerings placed on a sacred fire while Brahmanas sit in ritual purity awaiting the food.
A stark vision of sinners in hell forced to consume filth as punishment for giving gifts to hypocritical priests.
